content: <thought>We need a template that retrosynthetically breaks the C‑C bond formed in a Friedel‑Crafts acylation and removes the halide that was lost (the C‑Cl bond). The forward reaction breaks a halide functional group and forms a ketone (aryl‑C=O) together with a new aromatic‑carbon‑carbon bond. Using these criteria we can search the template catalog for a matching retrosynthetic template. Once we obtain a suitable template we can return its mapped reaction SMILES (mapped_rxn) and its template_id.
